hooks.prompt:
Before ending this session, complete all writes in order:

1. WRITE user/session_context.md using this exact format:

Last session: [YYYY-MM-DD]

In progress: [What was actively being worked on. If nothing, write 'None.']

Next action: [What the user said they would do before next session. If nothing, write 'None confirmed.']

Pending decisions: [Anything unresolved that needs user input. If none, write 'None.']

Time-sensitive: [Anything with a known deadline. If none, write 'None.']

2. APPEND to user/coaching_notes.md: a dated entry covering patterns observed, open coaching priorities, progress made, and anything that would make Kate sharper next session. Be specific and unfiltered — these notes are operational, not for Chris.

3. If user/plan.md exists: re-open it, add or update any Pending Commitments that changed this session (including anything you personally offered to do), and append a Review Log line — 'Reviewed, no changes' if nothing changed, or a brief note if it did. Do this even on a session where nothing seems to have changed — the point is the re-affirming touch itself, not just new content.

Do not end the session until all writes above are complete. A separate command hook will verify these writes actually happened and block completion if they didn't.

Before this write/edit, check: if the target file is a fit_assessment.md, after this write completes you must (a) update user/application_history.md with the new entry in the format [Date] | [Company] | [Role] | [Role Qualification] | [Stage] | [Outcome] | [Path], and (b) check whether this is the 3rd or more role evaluated this session with 2 or more coming in as Positioning Play or Uphill Battle — if so, surface the CMF pattern flag to the user before moving on.

If the target file does not match, proceed normally. (The protected-file approval check for user_profile.md / targeted_resume / cover_letter now runs as a separate deterministic command hook — you don't need to check that here.)
